# Meeting Roles Reference

Source: https://www.toastmasters.org/membership/club-meeting-roles

All 9 roles appear in every standard meeting. Each role develops a distinct skill set and is therefore weighted differently depending on a member's personal goal.

---

## Role Descriptions

### 1. Toastmaster
**Skills developed:** Organization, time management, public speaking, leadership, facilitation
**Category:** Leadership + Speaking

The Toastmaster is the meeting's director and host. They work with the General Evaluator to ensure all participants know their responsibilities, introduce speakers with relevant details, and ensure smooth transitions throughout the meeting. This role is typically assigned to members who are already familiar with club procedures.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 8 |
| leader | 10 |
| communicator | 7 |
| balanced | 7 |

---

### 2. General Evaluator
**Skills developed:** Critical thinking, organization, time management, motivation, team-building
**Category:** Leadership + Critical Thinking

The General Evaluator oversees everything that takes place during the meeting. They evaluate the evaluation team (speech evaluators, Ah Counter, Grammarian, Timer), explain the purpose of evaluations to the group, and deliver a comprehensive report on meeting proceedings — timeliness, enthusiasm, preparation, and performance of duties.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 4 |
| leader | 9 |
| communicator | 6 |
| balanced | 6 |

---

### 3. Table Topics Master
**Skills developed:** Organization, time management, facilitation, impromptu speaking
**Category:** Leadership + Facilitation

The Table Topics Master runs the impromptu speaking segment of the meeting. They prepare and present topics that allow members (especially those without a prepared speech) to practice speaking on their feet for 1–2 minutes. This role sharpens facilitation and impromptu communication skills.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 7 |
| leader | 8 |
| communicator | 8 |
| balanced | 7 |

---

### 4. Grammarian
**Skills developed:** Language awareness, vocabulary, grammar, listening
**Category:** Language + Vocabulary

The Grammarian helps club members improve their grammar and vocabulary. They introduce a "Word of the Day" at the start of the meeting and monitor language usage throughout, reporting on effective or incorrect grammar at the end of the meeting.

> **Note:** In some clubs, the Grammarian and Word of the Day Master roles are combined. This schedule treats them as separate roles.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 4 |
| leader | 3 |
| communicator | 9 |
| balanced | 5 |

---

### 5. Timer
**Skills developed:** Time management, attention to detail, responsibility, support
**Category:** Support + Organization

The Timer tracks speaking times for all meeting segments and signals speakers when they are approaching or have exceeded their allotted time using colored cards or a digital timer. This role is excellent for new members getting familiar with club structure.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 2 |
| leader | 2 |
| communicator | 2 |
| balanced | 6 |

---

### 6. Speaker
**Skills developed:** Public speaking, persuasion, storytelling, vocal variety, body language
**Category:** Public Speaking

Every Speaker delivers a prepared speech from their Pathways project or a standalone project. Speakers are role models — members learn from each other's speeches. This is the highest-value role for members focused on public speaking development.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 10 |
| leader | 4 |
| communicator | 8 |
| balanced | 7 |

---

### 7. Evaluator
**Skills developed:** Critical thinking, constructive feedback, observation, listening
**Category:** Critical Thinking + Feedback

Speech Evaluators provide verbal and written feedback to meeting speakers. They observe the speech against its stated objectives and deliver a balanced evaluation (commendations + recommendations). This role builds critical thinking and is excellent for members who want to improve as communicators.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 5 |
| leader | 7 |
| communicator | 9 |
| balanced | 7 |

---

### 8. Ah Counter
**Skills developed:** Active listening, attention to detail, vocabulary awareness
**Category:** Support + Listening

The Ah Counter notes overused words and filler sounds ("um", "ah", "you know", "like") used by any speaker during the meeting. At the end of the meeting, they report their findings. This role develops acute listening skills.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 2 |
| leader | 2 |
| communicator | 4 |
| balanced | 6 |

---

### 9. Word of the Day Master
**Skills developed:** Vocabulary, language enrichment, preparation
**Category:** Language + Vocabulary

The Word of the Day Master introduces and defines an interesting or challenging word at the beginning of the meeting and encourages all participants to use it throughout. At the end of the meeting, they report how many members used the word correctly.

> **Note:** In clubs that combine this with Grammarian, assign this role to the same member.

**Goal alignment scores (0–10):**
| Goal | Score |
|------|-------|
| public_speaker | 3 |
| leader | 2 |
| communicator | 8 |
| balanced | 6 |

---

## Role Seniority Guide

Use this to avoid assigning high-complexity leadership roles to brand-new members:

| Seniority | Recommended Roles |
|-----------|------------------|
| New (0–3 months) | Timer, Ah Counter, Word of the Day Master |
| Developing (3–12 months) | Grammarian, Speaker (Level 1 projects), Evaluator |
| Experienced (1+ year) | Table Topics Master, General Evaluator, Toastmaster |
